verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat platform with voice huddles, so screen sharing during a call is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only covers voice huddles and huddle audio ('drop into voice huddles', 'also hosts git + huddle audio', and '1:1 and group. Up to 9.'), with no mention of screen sharing. Audio-only huddles are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can share my screen during a call for live collaboration
